<template>
  <el-tag :type="tagType">{{ roleMap[value] || value }}</el-tag>
</template>

<script>
import { roleMap } from '../constants'

export default {
  name: 'RoleTag',
  props: {
    value: { type: String, default: '' }
  },
  data() {
    return { roleMap }
  },
  computed: {
    tagType() {
      const map = { admin: 'danger', maintenance: 'warning' }
      return map[this.value] || ''
    }
  }
}
</script>
